entities.name: Karin Rådström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karin Elisabeth Rådström is a Swedish engineer and business executive in the commercial vehicle segment. She has been a member of the Board of Management of Daimler Truck since February 2021 and has been responsible for the Mercedes-Benz truck brand there since May.
